craft_notes: Sthāyin: wish-joy. Fixed 'evermore' filler → end on knower. Close: knower. Rejected: 'guru' for jña — killed: knower kept; 'foe-less' — killed: unopposed kept.

lines: Spanda-flows from qualities, grounded in common spanda's core;
self-got self-gainers ever be, of the unopposed knower.
l4.sanskrit_cite: guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt | labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — who got self-getting ever may they be, of the unopposed knower.
c1_essence: Quality-born spanda-flows from common spanda; self-getters unopposed may be.
